items.title: Greg Caputo interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 14, 1998
items.q: I can remember doing a Frank Gorshin show, an impersonator, in Nassau.

ctx.x: Man you really have to be on the top of your game and alert for those things.

You try and be. Things happen that are just beyond your control. I can remember doing a Frank Gorshin show, an impersonator, in Nassau. And the piano player was a jazz player but not really versed in playing shows. And when we did the rehearsal everything was okay. But he didn’t put the music back in order. And Frank does like a country/western impersonation, an Elliot Ness, and he reversed those two charts. So when he came out with the hat and did the Elliot Ness thing, he played “Turkey in the Straw.” And it…
That’s opportunistic of him. If it gets a laugh, it must be good, right?
